abi.name: MSVC-v141-Win32-static-CRT
abi.runtime: Static MSVC CRT/STL and UCRT; no CRT sidecars

limitations: Experimental shared model/protocol/policy/recovery/diagnostic projection build, not a supported historical product.
Tests run on Windows 10 x64 through WOW64 unless a separate exact guest record says otherwise. XP/7 execution and desktop qualification remain unproven.
Native IPC, supervision, protected policy and UI adapters remain disabled until their historical contracts/imports are closed.
Intended XP SP3 x86 SSE2 floor is a hypothesis. PE imports and toolset selection are necessary but insufficient runtime proof.
Key installed tool/runtime/header files are pinned; complete archive/header closure and bit-for-bit reproduction remain unproven.
Bounded recent-failure codec is shared; native private-file recording/reading runs only on modern Windows/Linux profiles and has no product retention or power-loss guarantee.
